mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise Business License (Certificate of Incorporation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration under SAMR
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Destination in Hague Apostille Convention state: obtain PRC notarized copy, then apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China or authorized provincial Foreign Affairs Office. Destination non-member state: obtain PRC notarized copy, Foreign Affairs Office attestation, then Consular Legalization by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in the destination country. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain them sequentially. Validity 90 days.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Current Registration Status Record
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration under SAMR
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: notarized copy plus MOFA apostille. Non-member state path: notarized copy, Foreign Affairs Office attestation, then Chinese Consular Legalization. Use only one path based on destination status; do not combine apostille with consular legalization. Validity 90 days.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney for WFOE Formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign parent company board of directors, then notarized in parent company's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If parent jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention state: apostille issued by the competent authority of the parent jurisdiction, followed by notarized Chinese translation in mainland China. If parent jurisdiction is non-member state: consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in the parent jurisdiction, followed by notarized Chinese translation. These are alternate paths; never chain apostille and consular legalization. Validity 90 days.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: WFOE shareholders and PRC notary office, filed with SAMR
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For use abroad: PRC notarial deed of the Articles, then apostille by MOFA if destination is Hague member, or consular legalization by Chinese Embassy/Consulate if destination is non-member. Parallel materially different paths; choose only the path required by destination. Validity 90 days.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Financial Standing Confirmation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company's bank or a PRC licensed commercial bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If issued by a PRC bank: notarization, then MOFA apostille for Hague member destination or consular legalization for non-member destination. If issued by a foreign bank: apostille/consular legalization in the bank's jurisdiction as applicable, then notarized Chinese translation. Never sequence apostille and consular legalization together. Validity 90 days.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, directors, legal representatives and authorized signatories of the WFOE must be screened against the PRC State Administration for Market Regulation registration blacklists, public security databases, the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated sanctions list, HMT UK sanctions list, Interpol notices, and domestic PRC PEP lists. Enhanced continuous monitoring applies to politically exposed persons connected with public officials, plus adverse media and integrity checks. Screening must occur pre-onboarding, pre-transaction and on a rolling 24-hour basis using certified AML/CFT software, with threshold-based escalation, source-of-funds documentation and a full audit trail preserved for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Registration and Pre-approval Platform, accessible through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and local Municipal Market Supervision Administration online service portals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered official name must be in simplified Chinese characters. The four-tier naming convention is: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry or business characteristics + organization type. For a WFOE LLC, the name must end with Limited Liability Company or its approved Chinese equivalent. English names are not separately registered in mainland China; any English brand name used in TikTok creator contracts must be supported by the Chinese registered name through a phonetic or semantic transliteration. Pure foreign names, alphabetic-only names, and names likely to mislead as to legal form or national ownership are prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may resubmit an amended name through the SAMR online portal or file a written administrative reconsideration application with the local Market Supervision Administration within 60 days of rejection, citing the exact statutory refusal reason and providing an amended four-tier name structure, industry scope, UBO disclosure and lease evidence. If administrative reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit at the competent People's Court within six months. Any name containing a ministerial-approval token must be accompanied by the prior written approval letter from the relevant State Council department before a new filing can be accepted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a WFOE engaged in creator MCN agency activity, a pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible for company registration, tax registration or corporate bank account opening in mainland China. Local SAMR bureaus generally reject virtual mailbox addresses; tax authorities require a physical location for invoice management and field inspection; and banks require physical premises verification, onsite manager interview and utility bill matching. Some economic development zones offer officially registered business-park addresses, but banks and tax authorities are increasingly requiring proof of actual workspace, payroll and business operations. A TikTok MCN WFOE must maintain a real leased office with a valid lease contract, physical signage, workstations, employee records and accessible corporate books.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced on-site inspection risk is quantified at approximately 55% within the first twelve months after registration for MCN businesses using shared office or business-park addresses. Checklist for readiness: (1) lease tenant name matches the registered WFOE name; (2) physical business license conspicuously posted at the registered premises; (3) original lease, premises property ownership certificate, utility invoices and property management card on file; (4) fixed workstations and staff presence proportionate to declared payroll; (5) statutory books, UBO records and contract filing systems accessible; (6) tax registration and invoicing equipment located at the registered address; (7) at least one full-time qualified Chinese manager or legal representative on site during business hours; and (8) security guard and receptionist able to identify WFOE staff. Municipal tax bureaus, SAMR and public security authorities may conduct joint sweeps.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), adopted 29 December 2023 and effective 1 July 2024, particularly Articles 23, 24, 26, 27, 28, 29, 32, 33, 37, 46, 47, 49, 65 and 67; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 2, 4, 6, 15, 29 and 30; Implementing Regulations for the Foreign Investment Law; Provisions on the Administration of Market Entity Registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) of the People's Republic of China, acting through the local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) where the WFOE's registered office is located; online through the National Enterprise Registration Service Portal and local government integrated service platforms.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application Form for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company, accompanied by the Articles of Association of the Company and the Foreign Investment Information Report.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under current law. The PRC Company Law removes any minimum paid-in registered capital for an ordinary foreign-invested limited liability company, and shareholders determine the amount in the Articles of Association. However, every shareholder must contribute the full subscribed capital within five years after the company obtains its business license. There is no statutory blocked escrow account or bank capital verification requirement for a general ISIC 7310 creator talent and advertising agency. Inbound share capital must be remitted through lawful foreign exchange channels via a SAFE-designated bank and reported under the Foreign Investment Information Report and the enterprise credit information system.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the first meeting of the board of directors of the company, duly convened and held on the date stated above at the registered office, with all directors present in person or by proxy, that the actions taken by the incorporator and the sole shareholder are hereby ratified and confirmed, and that the following resolutions are adopted and shall be effective immediately. RESOLVED, in connection with the share capital subscription, that the registered capital of the company be established in the amount set forth in the Articles of Association, divided into ordinary shares of equal par value, that the sole shareholder's subscription be accepted, and that the directors and officers be authorized to open a capital contribution account with a commercial bank licensed by the People's Bank of China or the National Financial Regulatory Administration, to receive the subscribed capital in accordance with the contribution schedule, and to ensure that all share capital contributions are remitted in lawful currency through approved foreign exchange channels within the five-year statutory period. RESOLVED, in connection with banking authorization, that the legal representative, the chief financial officer, and such other persons designated by the board be appointed as signatories to open, operate, and maintain corporate bank accounts, current accounts, foreign exchange settlement accounts, and online payment facilities necessary to receive TikTok Creator Payout and Wise B2B remittances; that any two designated signatories shall be required to approve disbursements above the threshold set in the financial authorisation policy; and that all banking mandates be filed with the relevant banks and regulatory authorities. RESOLVED, in connection with registered office adoption, that the premises located at the address stated in the Articles of Association is approved as the sole registered office and principal place of business of the company, that the company lease, land certificate or landlord consent form be delivered to the local Administration for Market Regulation, and that the registered office address be correctly published in the National Enterprise Information Publicity System. RESOLVED, in connection with statutory officer appointments, that the directors and key officers named in the formation documents be appointed to the positions of legal representative, chief financial officer, company secretary and general manager, with authority to execute incorporation filings, tax registrations, social insurance registrations, SAFE foreign investment reports, and all employment, lease and payment-service contracts, and to establish the company seal use policy requiring dual approval for contracts and bank instruments. RESOLVED, that the directors and officers be authorized to execute all necessary documents, pay all official fees, engage professional advisers, procure the company seal, coordinate with state and local authorities, and do all such acts and things as may be required to perfect the incorporation and statutory governance of the company. Adopted unanimously and signed by all directors on the date first written above.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name pre-approval and availability clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) through the National Enterprise Registration Service Portal or the local government enterprise business hall.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the local Administration for Market Regulation online registration window or the national enterprise registration service platform and select the foreign-invested company establishment category. Perform a name availability search in the exact administrative district of the proposed registered office. The proposed Chinese name must follow the mandatory format of district, trade name, industry characteristic, and limited liability company suffix, and must not be confusingly similar to an existing company, trademark, or public institution. Submit the name reservation application using the real-name authentication of the legal representative or the appointed agent. A power of attorney in Chinese must be uploaded. The business scope should be translated to include internet information services for advertising and talent representation only, avoiding any licensed activity such as value-added telecommunication. Download the approved name reservation notice and use the reservation code for the establishment application.
required_dossiers: Proposed Chinese company name and English translation
Name reservation application form
Identity or registration certificate of the foreign investor
Power of attorney naming the local filer
Business scope description aligned with ISIC 7310 creator talent representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected, revise the proposed name and resubmit within five working days. If rejection is based on similarity, file a written explanation with a comparison table and supporting trademark or registration evidence, and request reconsideration by the local AMR; alternatively select a new name and preserve the amended reservation code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, notarization and submission of the establishment registration application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) or the district-level government service hall for foreign-invested enterprises.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute the Articles of Association in Chinese, together with the shareholders decision, the board consent, and the establishment registration application. The foreign investor's certificate of incorporation or identity document must be notarized in the country of origin and either apostilled or legalized by the Chinese embassy or consulate, with a certified Chinese translation attached. If the investor is a company, its board resolution authorizing the WFOE and the appointment of the legal representative must also be legalized. Submit the complete application electronically through the local AMR portal or in person at the district-level government service hall. The AMR reviews the proposed registered capital, shareholder identity, contribution schedule, business scope, directors, supervisor, and registered office address. When any query is issued, amend the electronic forms and upload the supplementary explanation. After the final approval, the AMR issues a business license bearing a unified social credit code.
required_dossiers: Notarized and consular-legalized or apostilled foreign investor certificate
Certified Chinese translation of the foreign investor certificate
Articles of Association in Chinese
Establishment registration application form
Shareholders resolution and board resolutions of the foreign investor
Letters of appointment of directors, legal representative, supervisor and officers
Proof of registered office address, such as a lease agreement, property certificate or landlord consent
Identity documents of the legal representative, directors and supervisor
Name reservation notice from the AMR portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AMR suspends the application, review the query notice and respond within ten working days through the same portal. If the legalization or translation is defective, obtain a corrected apostille or consular certificate and a fresh certified translation, then upload a supplement. If the business scope contains unlicensed wording, narrow it and re-file before the deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining business license, engraving seals and post-establishment registration filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) and a public-security licensed seal engraving enterprise.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the AMR approves the establishment, download the electronic business license or collect the paper license from the government service hall. There is no SAMR registration fee due for ordinary WFOE establishment. Arrange for the engraving of the company seal, finance seal, invoice seal, contract seal, and legal representative seal at a public-security licensed engraving enterprise. Keep the engraving receipt and a seal use register. File the seal specimen records with the public security authority if local rules require such filing. Next, register the company's open-bank-account information and legal representative records with the AMR, and use the electronic license to perform real-name verification on the nationwide enterprise credit system. If any shareholder contribution is paid in, record the paid-in capital and the date of contribution in the enterprise credit information system. Maintain a statutory register of members and board resolutions at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Approved business license from the AMR
Name reservation notice
Articles of Association in Chinese
Application form for seal engraving authorized by the legal representative
Identity proof of the legal representative and the designated seal custodian
Engraving receipt and seal specimen registration form if required by public security
Statutory register of members and board resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal engraving is delayed by public security inspection, temporarily use the legal representative signature and an undertaking letter in contracts, then complete the engraving after approval. If the AMR does not record the paid-in capital, submit a written statement and the bank capital remittance voucher within fifteen working days to correct the enterprise credit information.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, social insurance and foreign exchange registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local office of the State Taxation Administration (STA), Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through SAFE-designated banks.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete tax registration through the electronic tax bureau using the unified social credit code; the tax registration is integrated with the AMR license and does not require a separate certificate. Register the company for value-added tax, corporate income tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, social insurance, medical insurance, and housing fund. Appoint a financial officer responsible for monthly and quarterly tax declarations and annual corporate income tax settlement. For inbound share capital, submit the Foreign Investment Information Report and apply to a SAFE-designated bank for a foreign exchange account, capital account or settlement account, providing the board resolution and the bank account opening certificate. Once the accounts are active, configure payment rails for TikTok Creator Payout and Wise B2B, ensuring the services rendered are not prohibited under the restricted foreign investment negative list. Conduct a PEP and AML risk assessment as required by the corporate banking institution, even though the standard risk tier is low.
required_dossiers: Business license with the unified social credit code
Articles of Association and registration information
Legal representative and CFO identity documents
Tax registration form if separate filing is required
Foreign Investment Information Report receipt
FDI foreign exchange registration form required by the designated bank
Bank account opening certificate
Board resolution authorizing signatories and payment rails
Lease contract for the operating premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority issues a risk notification, file an explanation and supporting lease, invoice, and bank records in the electronic tax bureau. If the designated bank rejects the foreign exchange registration, cure by supplying the board resolution, the latest Articles of Association, the Foreign Investment Information Report receipt, and the business license, then resubmit to another SAFE-designated bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board ratification, annual reporting and ongoing statutory compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, local Administration for Market Regulation, and the local office of the State Taxation Administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After license issuance, convene the first board meeting to ratify the incorporation steps, adopt the financial authorization matrix, approve the seal control policy, and appoint the auditor or accounting firm. Submit the annual enterprise information report through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System before the statutory deadline, disclosing the registered capital, shareholders, paid-in contribution, changes, and operational information. File monthly payroll, social insurance, individual income tax withholding, and quarterly VAT returns; prepare the annual corporate income tax return and audited financial statements if required. Notify the local AMR of any change in directors, legal representative, address, capital, or business scope. If the company offers a website or application for creator services, complete the ICP filing and public security filing before going live; for a pure creator-talent representation agency, no industrial operating license, environmental permit, or civil defense fire permit is required.
required_dossiers: Statutory books including register of members and board minutes
Financial authorization matrix approved by the board
Company seal control policy and seal use register
Annual enterprise information report form
Financial statements and corporate income tax returns
Payroll, social insurance and withholding tax filings
Office lease and any tenant-side fire safety compliance documents if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual report is listed for non-disclosure, file a correction report immediately and pay any administrative fee if applicable; if an officer appointment is challenged, convene a board meeting and file amended director and legal representative registration. For tax arrears, pay the principal and late fee, submit supplemental returns, and apply for administrative reconsideration or tax payment installment relief in accordance with the Tax Administration Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — no industrial licensing board has jurisdiction over an ISIC 7310 advertising and creator talent agency using office-based digital services.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — pure digital/consulting service; no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing license is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable — not within the environmental impact assessment category list because there is no construction or production project.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable — no wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste handling; no discharge permit required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable — no Civil Defense fire permit, structural load inspection, or industrial workplace safety approval required for an office-based creator MCN agency. The company must only observe general Fire Control Law and Work Safety Law obligations for leased office premises, such as maintaining accessible exits and safe electrical equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), operating through local STA branches and the national online e-Tax portal (Electronic Tax Bureau; https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn). Customs-related export declarations are filed through the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) is incorporated with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); the business license automatically carries the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the statutory tax identification number (TIN) for the entity. Step 2: Within 30 days after business registration, the WFOE must complete taxpayer registration and tax type filing through the STA e-Tax portal or in person at the competent local STA branch. No separate TIN certificate is issued because the USCC is the TIN; the electronic tax registration record activates the obligations for corporate income tax, VAT, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, individual income tax withholding, and stamp duty. Step 3: For a foreign non-resident entity without an establishment or place of business in China, the non-resident enterprise or its Chinese withholding agent must file a non-resident enterprise tax registration through the same e-Tax portal, submitting the foreign entity's incorporation documents, identification of the responsible person, and contracts evidencing China-source taxable transactions. The STA then assigns a non-resident TIN, which is used for contract/tax registration, filing, and obtaining withholding certificates. Step 4: All subsequent changes in address, legal representative, capital, or business scope must be updated in the e-Tax portal, and the USCC or non-resident TIN must be referenced consistently in VAT invoices, customs declarations, foreign exchange receipts, tax filings, and export rebate submissions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise taxed on its worldwide income at the statutory 25% corporate income tax rate; pass-through treatment is not available. For VAT purposes, the entity is classified either as a small-scale VAT taxpayer or a general VAT taxpayer depending on annual taxable turnover and its election, but the entity-level CIT classification remains the default.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None comparable to U.S. check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. China has no unilateral entity classification election for tax transparency. Available elections include: voluntary registration as a general VAT taxpayer if annual taxable sales are below the mandatory RMB 5,000,000 threshold; application of small-scale VAT taxpayer preferential treatment where eligible; election to claim zero-rating or VAT exemption for cross-border taxable services by filing the required transaction documentation with the STA; and election by a non-resident shareholder to claim treaty benefits under an applicable double tax agreement to reduce China withholding tax rates.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: PRC Value Added Tax (VAT), governed by the Interim Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Value-Added Tax, the VAT transition rules, and the comprehensive business-tax-to-VAT reform measures under Caishui [2016] No. 36.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT taxpayer registration is mandatory for the WFOE at establishment with no turnover threshold. Mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer is triggered when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; below that amount, the taxpayer may remain a small-scale VAT taxpayer or elect general taxpayer status if its accounting records are sound. Small-scale VAT taxpayers are generally taxed at a reduced levy rate, while the general VAT rate applicable to the WFOE's advertising and MCN agency services is 6%; the headline China VAT rate for goods is 13% and the rate for certain transportation, construction, and real-property services is 9%.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates a fully digitalized electronic invoice (FDEI) regime. Taxable enterprises must issue VAT invoices through the STA e-invoice platform or through STA-certified commercial software connected by application programming interface (API). Each FDEI is transmitted in real time to the STA Golden Tax System and carries a unique invoice code, invoice number, QR code, and tax-control digital signature, enabling real-time authenticity verification, duplicate detection, and cross-matching with customs declaration data, bank payment data, and VAT returns. Paper VAT special invoices, where still used, are tax-control invoices generated from the VAT invoice management system and must be reconciled with the STA-ledger database. There is no separate municipal physical fiscal stamp; compliance is enforced through real-time digital transmission and anti-fraud validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods: zero-rating is available for physical exports from the PRC customs territory provided the goods are lawfully reported in a Customs Export Declaration, physically leave China, are not prohibited or restricted for export, the exporter has title and valid sales evidence, and the export proceeds are collected in foreign currency and repatriated to China. For services: zero-rating is available only for taxable services expressly listed as zero-rated cross-border services in Annex IV to Caishui [2016] No. 36, which includes categories such as international transportation, research and development, design, software and information technology services, and other specifically enumerated offshore services supplied to an overseas entity and wholly used or consumed outside China. General MCN creator representation and advertising agency services are ordinarily treated as cross-border taxable services that may qualify for VAT exemption rather than 0% zero-rating, unless a separately priced and separately documented line item falls within the enumerated zero-rated service catalogue. In all cases, the taxpayer must prove the offshore recipient identity, genuine cross-border supply, offshore consumption or destination, contractual chain, and economic substance of the transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration Form filed through the China International Trade Single Window and released by customs)
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration data
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or international consignment note evidencing physical export from China

Export proceeds collection receipt (Foreign Exchange Collection Receipt / Inward Remittance Certificate) issued by a designated foreign exchange bank, or the electronic receipt record in the SAFE trade in goods/foreign exchange administration platform
Cross-border service agreement, statement of work, delivery records, and evidence of offshore use or consumption for zero-rated or exempt cross-border services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA customs and foreign-exchange authorities cross-match every zero-rated export claim against the VAT invoice database, Customs Export Declaration, logistics records, bills of lading, foreign-exchange collection receipts, banking records, and the underlying commercial contracts. If the zero-rating or export refund is unsupported, reversed, or found fraudulent, the STA will claw back the VAT refunded or exempted, impose a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the underpaid tax, and may impose a fine of between 50% and 500% of the tax involved under the Law of the People's Republic on the Administration of Tax Collection. The tax authority may also suspend the taxpayer's export VAT refund rights and require retrospective adjustment for prior periods. Fraudulently obtaining export tax refunds constitutes a crime under the PRC Criminal Law, carrying possible imprisonment and criminal fines, and the limitation period for serious fiscal fraud is extended or unlimited while the matter remains concealed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime with RMB convertibility split between current and capital accounts. Current account transactions, including trade-related service fees and creator remittances, are generally freely convertible if supported by authentic commercial documentation under SAFE's principle of 'real need' verification. However, capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment capital injections, cross-border shareholder loans, and outward portfolio investments, remain subject to pre-approval, registration, and quantitative controls. Foreign exchange collected from export activities and cross-border service revenue must be repatriated to China and may be retained in foreign currency accounts or settled into RMB; the ability to remit profits offshore is allowed only after annual statutory audit, corporate income tax settlement, and SAFE verification of tax payment certificates. Practical hurdles include the requirement for verified underlying contracts, invoices, and safe custody of evidence; any mismatch in the declared purpose code or settlement pattern triggers compliance review. Profit remittances require clearing through a designated bank in China, with the tax authorities' Certificate of Tax Payment or tax withholding statement, and cannot be effected via unlicensed offshore fintech channels.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export foreign exchange receipts from goods and services must be repatriated into China within 90 days from the date of export customs declaration or the service completion date, and must be credited to a current account foreign exchange account at a designated domestic bank. There is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio under the current managed regime, but the proceeds may be converted into RMB upon settlement; all transactions must be verified under SAFE's trade authenticity review, and any retained foreign currency must be reported in the enterprise's foreign exchange receipts and payments monitoring system. Certain special categories such as processing trade or advance receipts may be subject to earlier repatriation deadlines or additional verification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for Foreign Direct Investment and RMB Basic Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Deposit Account for RMB Operations and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account
Current Account in Foreign Exchange and RMB Basic Account
Foreign Exchange Capital Settlement Account and RMB Common Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-Border Viability Rating: Low as a primary legal clearing rail. Under PBOC/SAFE regulations, unlicensed offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise or Airwallex cannot open RMB basic deposit accounts, cannot clear domestic creator payouts, and cannot hold client funds in a bank-guaranteed manner within China. They may be used only as supplementary cross-border remittance aggregators that route funds through licensed domestic partner banks; however, a WFOE must maintain its primary treasury and tax clearing through a licensed Chinese bank. Any outbound service-fee disbursement to global TikTok creators must be settled via a Chinese bank with a service trade purpose code; settlement through foreign EMIs without a local money services license exposes the entity to illegal cross-border remittance charges and SAFE sanctions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The legal representative, at least one director, and the financial controller must appear physically at the Chinese bank branch for the initial KYC interview and the resolution-based opening of the entity's basic RMB account. A remote consular proxy is not accepted for statutory account opening; however, after the initial in-person visit, the bank may permit subsequent updates via video or email. Foreign shareholders and UBOs must deliver original certificates of incorporation, certificates of good standing, and board resolutions legalized by the Chinese embassy/consulate or an apostille where applicable, with certified Chinese translation. For WFOEs, the registered legal representative must be present to sign the account opening documents and the bank's anti-money-laundering questionnaire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership veil: ultimate human controllers of the offshore MCN group are hidden behind multiple Hong Kong/Singapore holding entities and nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide notarized certificate of good standing for each upstream holding company; full share registry with nominee declarations; individual passport copies of all natural-person UBOs above 25% equity; signed statutory declaration from the ultimate UBO; and an organizational chart mapping the group to TikTok MCN contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual inbound capital injection from a third-party lender or related affiliate rather than the direct foreign shareholder; the bank flags source-of-funds and capital verification mismatch.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide original foreign exchange registration certificate for FDI, board resolution for the capital call, audited financial statements of the shareholder, SWIFT MT103 showing exact remitter and beneficiary, bank certificate of inward remittance, and a capital verification report issued by a licensed Chinese CPA.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border creator payout remittances to a high-volume list of overseas TikTok influencers show no clear service contract or platform payout ledger; potential structuring or round-tripping.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier must include the signed creator management agreements, TikTok official payout statements showing transaction IDs, tax invoices or equivalent receipts, creator IDs and tax resident declarations, and the company's service trade foreign exchange registration evidence with invoice or contract matching.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business scope mismatch: entity registered under ISIC 7310 advertising agency, yet actual commercial activity is creator talent representation and MCN monetization; the bank questions whether the WFOE is engaging in unlicensed cultural or content-distribution activities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amend the WFOE's business license by adding internet cultural operations, creator agency, and talent management in the business scope; provide SAFE or relevant cultural license exemption letters; submit a detailed business model narrative with revenue recognition policy; and maintain a functional segregation of creative service fee invoicing versus content distribution.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment must be routed through a designated domestic bank using a SWIFT wire from the direct overseas shareholder only. The remittance purpose should be designated with FDI capital injection code 621011 and the Chinese bank must be presented with the SAFE Foreign Exchange Registration Certificate for FDI, the board resolution, and photocopies of the shareholder's registration. Upon receipt, the bank will credit the capital account and the WFOE must complete settlement into RMB under SAFE's follow-up verification; a licensed CPA then issues the capital verification report. Any use of a third-party remitter will be rejected; if the parent uses an offshore treasury center, the payment must be accompanied by a channel agreement confirming the beneficial owner and the absence of money laundering risk.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational disbursements to overseas creators and production suppliers, the WFOE should use SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for service fees under the current account with the appropriate SAFE purpose code, such as advertising and marketing or management and consulting fees, supported by contracts and commercial invoices. Commodity-related trade settlements may be processed via commercial letters of credit at sight or term, or documentary collections where the counterpart is a goods supplier; however, for digital MCN payments, MT103 is the normal rail. The bank will perform transaction monitoring and may require e-invoicing reconciliation, source-of-funds evidence, and beneficial ownership declarations for each payee. If the bank refuses a remittance due to incomplete documentation, the WFOE must file a supplementary declaration through the bank's foreign exchange verification system and obtain approval before resubmission.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable RMB forward contracts with a licensed Chinese bank for genuine underlying commercial exposure
Onshore cross-currency swaps for foreign currency debt or capital account hedging under the real demand principle
RMB options provided by a licensed domestic bank for current account cash flow hedging

Offshore non-deliverable forwards are not permissible for direct onshore WFOE hedging due to SAFE and PBOC restrictions; only offshore affiliates may transact NDFs with clear board approval and no internal netting with the WFOE unless conducted on arm's length terms

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Information Report (annual return publication on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Market Supervision Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June each year, covering the preceding calendar year; no anniversary-based filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to publish by 30 June: SAMR records the WFOE in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations within 10 working days; if unrectified for 3 consecutive years, the WFOE is moved to the List of Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprises and becomes subject to multi-department joint credit discipline, government procurement and tax-incentive restrictions, and SAMR registration-enforcement action, including possible cancellation or revocation of the business license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information Annual Report (FDI annual information report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System jointly with SAMR and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June each year for the immediately preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or filing false information: MOFCOM orders correction within a prescribed time limit; failure to correct may incur a fine of up to RMB 100,000 under the Foreign Investment Law, plus abnormal-list and foreign-exchange or compliance restrictions affecting repatriation and subsequent filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement Return and Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 May of the year immediately following the tax year; extended deadlines are available only where the tax authority approves a special case, and otherwise any later date is delinquent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues a daily non-deductible late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax; failure to file timely can be fined up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 where serious, and continued delinquency exposes the WFOE to enforced collection, bank-account freeze, asset seizure, legal-representative exit restriction, and possible de-registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Financial Statements and Independent Auditor's Report (CPA audit file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting of the WFOE, with a copy kept at the registered office and presented to SAMR, STA and SAFE on lawful statutory demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Prepared at each fiscal year-end and submitted to the shareholders before the annual shareholders' meeting, which is required no later than six months after year-end; finalised before 31 May where the audited numbers support the CIT annual settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unaudited or inaccurate financial reporting violates PRC Company Law and the Accounting Law; directors and the legal representative may be liable for damages and regulatory correction orders; this may also taint the SAMR annual report and Foreign Investment Information Report and can be used as basis for administrative penalty or untrustworthy listing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under PRC Company Law (Article 164), every limited liability company, including a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, must engage a PRC-licensed CPA firm to audit its annual financial report; there is no de minimis turnover, balance-sheet or headcount exemption for a WFOE LLC. The only quantitative classification relevant to the accounting framework is the PRC small-enterprise classification for accounting-standard selection (full CAS vs simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standards), but this does not remove the mandatory audit obligation. Public-interest-entity, listed-company or financial-regulated thresholds would additionally apply if the group is listed or regulated; this private TikTok MCN WFOE is not a public-interest entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE), which are substantially converged with IFRS; a small-qualifying domestic enterprise may apply the simplified PRC Small Enterprise Accounting Standards, but a WFOE with cross-border parent group reporting generally maintains its PRC statutory books under full CAS and may prepare a supplementary IFRS group reporting package for consolidation outside China.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not require a standalone annual UBO return; instead, the WFOE must report beneficial owner information to SAMR under the Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC/SAMR, effective 1 November 2024) at incorporation and must update that information within 30 days of any reportable change, including a transfer of shares or change in voting control. Independently, any change in registered capital, shareholders, directors, legal representative, business scope, articles of association or foreign-ownership structure must be filed with SAMR within 30 days, and a change in foreign-investment information, including an equity transfer in a WFOE, is reported through the foreign investment information system within 30 days. The 1 January to 30 June annual enterprise report is the annual confirmation vehicle for the preceding year's shareholding and UBO data; failure to report accurately attracts correction orders, fines and abnormal listing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200 - USD 1,200 per year for a compliant registered address and local corporate agent; actual leased office space in Tier-1 Chinese cities is additional and is a commercial cost outside statutory renewal fees.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,000 - USD 5,000 for a standard private WFOE; a TikTok MCN agency with cross-border creator payouts, intercompany service agreements and transfer-pricing documentation will typically fall in the USD 3,000 - USD 8,000 range.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small Low-Profit Enterprise: 20% effective rate for annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, assets not exceeding RMB 50 million, employees not exceeding 300; qualified High-Technology New Enterprise: 15%; additional Super Deduction for R&D expenses (200%).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form A100000) with schedules A100000, A105000, A107040 etc., filed through the China Electronic Tax Filing System (e-Tax, electronic portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return (with quarterly provisional prepayments on Form A200000)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within 5 months of the fiscal year-end (May 31); quarterly prepayments due within 15 days after each quarter-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue (business income) including TikTok creator commissions, MCN agency service fees, and other operating receipts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report global-source revenue attributable to the China WFOE under PRC EIT territorial rules. Foreign-sourced income attributable to the WFOE must be included and may be subject to foreign tax credit. Exclude non-resident dividend income if separately taxed at source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of business operations (creator acquisition costs, talent development costs, content production costs, platform fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply arm's-length standards to intercompany payments for creator services and content licensing. Correctly allocate costs to Chinese-source vs foreign-source income. Excessive payments to the offshore parent may require transfer pricing adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxes and surcharges (consumption tax, business tax legacy, surcharges on VAT)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure VAT on cross-border digital services and royalties is properly handled. Surcharges are deductible for EIT purposes only if actually paid and economically borne.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Period expenses (selling, administrative, and financial expenses)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only expenses that are reasonable, substantiated with invoices, and related to income generation. Intercompany management fees must satisfy arm's-length plus benefit-test rules; pure profit-sharing charges are non-deductible.
Compute accurately from audited financial statements. Watch for thin-capitalization interest disallowance (debt-to-equity ratio 2:1; 5:1 for financial institutions) on intercompany loans.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation of accounting profit to taxable income, including add-backs for non-deductible entertainment, fines, and non-compliant intercompany charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all permanent and temporary differences. Transfer pricing self-adjustment must be reflected on Schedule A105000; failure to report related-party transactions triggers separate penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax incentives and reduced rates (small low-profit enterprise relief, high-tech enterprise rate)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify qualification thresholds for any preferential rate. WFOE acting as an MCN agency normally does not qualify for high-tech status unless independent R&D and IP creation is demonstrable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit and withholding credits for income sourced abroad
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE pays foreign income tax on creator royalties received from abroad, claim FTC under the deemed-paid credit regime. The credit is limited to the Chinese EIT payable on the same foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transactions disclosure (Form A108000 and accompanying transfer pricing documentation schedules)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory disclosure of all transactions with overseas affiliates. Failure to file or provide contemporaneous documentation shifts the burden of proof and triggers penalty assessments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable (after prepayments, credits, and withholding amounts)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settle the final balance by May 31. Under withholding is regarded as tax evasion if intentional. Ensure the foreign parent's dividend withholding is separately handled at the time of distribution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual EIT return: 2,000 RMB to 10,000 RMB penalty (up to 100,000 RMB for serious cases); 0.05% daily surcharge on unpaid tax from the original due date; fraudulent under-reporting – 50% to 500% additional tax based on the amount evaded; criminal liability under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 where tax evasion exceeds RMB 50,000 (imprisonment up to 7 years). Failure to file related-party transaction forms triggers RMB 5,000 to 50,000 penalty plus mandatory investigation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax on dividends distributed to non-resident enterprises; reduced to 5% under applicable Double Taxation Treaties (DTA) where beneficial owner holds at least 25% of the capital (e.g., under the China-Hong Kong DTA), subject to substance requirements.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Beneficial owner must apply for treaty relief through the Chinese non-resident taxpayer withholding tax filing system. Substantiate the claim with (1) the Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, accompanied by the Form 501 (Statement of Claim for Tax Treaty Benefits) filed with the local tax bureau before the dividend payment, (2) evidence of beneficial ownership and no pass-through arrangement, (3) certificate of shareholding period exceeding 12 months for the 5% reduced rate, and (4) supporting financial statements proving the shareholder is not a shell entity. Timely application is essential; retroactive relief is not generally granted and the tax authority can deny if the beneficial owner test fails.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on royalties and interest paid to non-residents: 10% for both; treaty rates vary (e.g., 5% for royalties and 7% for interest under China-Hong Kong DTA; 10% for both with no treaty reduction). For MCN agencies, keynote caution: payments for creator content licensing and user-generated content may be re-characterized as royalty income if the payment is for the right to use copyrighted content; avoid misclassifying service income as royalty. Interest on intercompany loans must be at arm's length and beneficial ownership substantiated, otherwise can be re-characterized as hidden dividend.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File preparation arises when related-party transactions exceed: RMB 200 million for tangible asset purchases/sales, RMB 100 million for intangible asset transfers or financial transactions (loans), RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions in the fiscal year. Master File required where total related-party transactions exceed RMB 3 billion (or revenue > RMB 5 billion and related-party percentage material).
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: PRC General Anti-Avoidance Rules (GAAR) under Article 47 of the EIT Law and Public Notice 2009 No. 2 apply; although no formal ESR framework, the tax authorities may apply substance-over-form and economic substance principles to recharacterize transactions. For a WFOE managing TikTok creators, Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) must include strategic and operational management, contract negotiation, creator development, and risk-bearing functions within China to avoid PE risk and to support the arm's-length allocation of profits. The effective management and control of the WFOE must remain in China; otherwise Article 8(2) and Article 45 of EIT Law could attribute profits to the offshore parent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Not declaring TikTok creator commissions and MCN agency fees collected through an offshore receiving account or a foreign payment platform, deferring revenue recognition, or creating false service agreements with the offshore parent to shift revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC EIT Law Article 49, Implementation Regulations Article 133, and Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63: recovery of the underpaid tax, daily surcharge of 0.05% per day, and additional monetary penalty of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax; criminal liability under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 if the amount evaded exceeds RMB 50,000 (imprisonment up to 7 years plus an unlimited fine).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the responsible tax officer are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax, and assets may be seized for restitution; personal travel bans (exit restrictions) may be imposed by the tax authority (Tax Collection Administration Law Article 44). In the event of intentional evasion, the director as the decision-maker will face criminal prosecution and imprisonment; corporate veil-piercing can be invoked to hold the foreign parent liable if the subsidiary is entirely a puppet and the parent controls funding and revenue.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company – Inadequate Economic Substance and sham proportionate allocation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering the WFOE as a conduit that only signs contracts but performs no real creator management or decision-making, with all profits repatriated to the offshore parent through dividends or management fees, while the Chinese entity lacks employees, office space, and operational substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 47 and Public Notice 2009 No. 2 (GAAR): discretionary re-characterization of the WFOE as a pure shell, denial of treaty benefits, and reallocation of profits to the higher-taxing jurisdiction; penalties under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63 for false declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the shell structure enables tax abuse, directors who sign the sham contracts and authorise tax filings may be held personally liable for the superior amount of tax, interest, and penalties; an exit ban can be issued and the director's personal assets attached. The onus lies on the director to demonstrate legitimate business purpose; failure leads to criminal liability for fraudulent tax refund or evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation – Inflated Offshore Service Fees and Royalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying large management, consulting, or royalty fees to a Hong Kong or BVI affiliate for Tiktok algorithm advice, trademark usage, or 'global headquarters services' that are not actually performed, or which have little relation to the value created; failing to prepare or file a timely Local File, or submitting false comparables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 41 (arm's length principle), Article 46 (thin capitalization), Public Notice 2016 No. 42 (transfer pricing documentation), and Public Notice 2017 No. 6 (special tax investigation adjustment and mutual agreement procedures). The tax authority can make a transfer pricing adjustment, charge interest on the adjusted tax, and impose a surcharge; intentional evasion triggers a 50%-500% fine. Criminal enforcement can extend to imprisonment for tax evasion above RMB 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable if they approve the intercompany fraud and the WFOE becomes insolvent when the adjustment is imposed; the corporate veil can be pierced to recover the tax from the director's private assets. Additionally, the offshore affiliate's directors may be criminally liable as joint offenders, and the responsible Chinese director can face a travel ban and extradition issues under the OECD/BEPS framework.
